services.metaDescription: Kamera z'umutekano, amarembo yikoresha, kugenzura kwinjira, imiyoboro ya interineti, gukora ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga n'amahugurwa ya tekiniki ku ngo, ubucuruzi n'ibigo mu Rwanda.
services.title: Serivisi zacu za tekiniki
services.intro: Muri 3Sixty Technologies Ltd, dutanga ibisubizo bishya by'ikoranabuhanga bigenewe gutuma ingo, ubucuruzi n'ibigo birushaho kugira ubwenge, umutekano no gukora neza. Kuva ku buryo bugezweho bw'umutekano n'ikoranabuhanga ryikoresha kugeza ku bikorwa remezo bya IT, gukora ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga n'amahugurwa ya tekiniki, dutanga ibisubizo byizewe bishyigikiwe n'ubuhanga bw'umwuga.
